mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.name categoryName, u.username sellerName FROM second_book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id
SELECT b.*,c.name categoryName, u.username sellerName FROM second_book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id WHERE b.status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM second_book WHERE status = 1
AND category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO second_book(name, author, price, level, book_desc, image, seller_id, status, category_id) VALUES(#{name}, #{author}, #{price}, #{level}, #{bookDesc}, #{image}, #{sellerId}, #{status}, #{categoryId})
mapper.select: SELECT b.*,c.name categoryName, u.username sellerName FROM second_book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id WHERE b.status = 1 AND b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')

SELECT b.*,c.name categoryName, u.username sellerName FROM second_book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id WHERE b.status = 1 AND (b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT b.*, c.name categoryName, u.username sellerName FROM second_book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id WHERE b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.seller_id AS sellerId, u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS soldCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status IN ('received', 'shipped') THEN o.id END) AS completedCount, COALESCE(AVG(c.score), 0) AS avgScore FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.seller_id = u.id LEFT JOIN comment c ON c.order_id = o.id WHERE o.seller_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.seller_id, u.username ORDER BY soldCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
